about_the_game:
😅 Let me ask you this:

  • If life gave you a second chance…
    What kind of person would you become?

  • Would you coast through life with the knowledge of the future like a lazy time traveler?

  • Or would you break your own limits—and become the Emperor of America?

👊 Next life, fight harder!

  • In your past life, you were a code monkey buried in bugs and 996 shifts, living a life defined by social awkwardness and crippling insecurity.

  • This life?
    You’re still holding a dishcloth—but your mind holds the blueprint for a revolutionary app.
    Armed with memories of the future, you decide it’s time to stir up the world.

🌎 You’ll go through:

  • Dishwashing Chronicles: Swallow your pride and code between shifts!

  • Capitalist Thunderdome: Raise funds, crush competitors, move a billion units—and casually acquire the White House.

  • Presidential Debate Livestream PK: Roast “Donny the Builder” on live TikTok, dominate the polls, and rule the Free World.

  • Rewrite the law. Rule them all.

🤡 Game Features

  • Dialogue dripping with black humor and satire.

  • A cartoonish, ridiculous art style to match the madness.

  • Experience the jaw-dropping life of Jack Ma 2.0, from busboy to Emperor of America.

⚠️This is a text-based adventure game where you make choices for your second chance at life. Every decision matters.

name: Rebirth: I Became the Emperor of America by Creating TokTik
short_description: In my past life, I was a broke, repressed code monkey—laid off, heartbroken, a full-on loser. My life was a running joke. In this life, I started as a dishwasher, created FakeTok, ran for president, and rose to become the Emperor of America!

English*, Simplified Chinese*
*languages with full audio support
